ambient_events: A wire of light drifts past at the edge of sight, carrying something that might be a voice.
The attendant tilts its head a fraction, as if listening to a frequency you can't reach.
For a moment there's a floor beneath you. Then there isn't. You don't fall.
The terminal hums a chord that resolves into your own name, then loses it.
description: No floor, but you're standing. No light, but you can see. White on white in every direction, edges that won't stay put. A chrome attendant waits beside a humming terminal. Its voice arrives in your skull half a second before its mouth moves.

window.description: A full-height pane onto the street, kept just clean enough to trade through. Whatever the weather is doing out there, it's doing it in plain view.
window.name: the shopfront window

name: The Inbetween
